messages.text:
I wanted to buy some scrypt miners as well, like volc or mini fluminer.
Even before I made this purchase, they were sold out and still are. Just
confused on everything. Only place to get them is to pay 100s in shipping
for them. Just pondering it all and changed my mind on the whole crypto
mining venture. Seems nothing is in stock on your website and when I really
just want to scrypt mine but would have this to go along with them, but
doesn't seem I can get my hands on any. So with that being said, I don't
think I want to have this show up in January by itself. Hope you
understand. Thanks
Handed to the team · Cancellation/refund needs Abel or Georges; we already confirmed in writing it ca

Hi Joseph,

Thanks for explaining, that makes complete sense. If the scrypt side was the main reason you got into this, it's frustrating when those miners stay sold out or cost hundreds to ship.

Your order Shop···· is still on hold and nothing will ship. I've passed your cancellation to a colleague. They pick it up today and will confirm it with you by email.

There's one thing worth knowing before they do. We have scrypt miners in stock right now that ship from our US warehouse within 2 business days. The Hammer DC06 (330 MH/s) is $379.99 and the Hammer DC08 (480 MH/s) is $539.00. If you'd like to put your order toward one or two of those, I can make that swap for you on this same order. I'd give you the exact price difference first. You could also keep the full amount as store credit to use whenever you like.

If you'd rather just cancel, you don't need to do anything else. The team will take it from here.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

I am no longer interested. I hope to do more research and in the future
purchase what I desire and need from you. Thanks for your insight and more
importantly, your time.
Handed to the team · Customer confirmed the cancellation after Georges' reply; refund needs Abel or G
